_comment: Consent precedence conformance vector (F6/S6). Order: a stored visitor decision (skips everything below), then the project's consent_mode and geo consent_default from GET /v1/config, then the page's consent.mode, then the SDK default (opt_out). The project can only make it stricter. page_mode null = the page passes no consent config. effective = the mode the visitor starts in once the config answered; until then (and when it never answers: fail closed) it is opt_in: no storage write and no request except the config fetch, which carries only the public key. Every browser SDK must pass these.

cases.name: project opt_out never loosens page opt_in
project off keeps the SDK default
project silent keeps the SDK default
page opt_in stays without a project mode
